# QareGO merchant partner agreement

> **DRAFT for legal review.** Have a lawyer qualified in Ghana review this agreement before anyone signs it. Fill in everything in `[square brackets]`. It must stay consistent with the public [Terms of Service](https://qarego.com/terms).

**This agreement is between:**

**Qaretech** `[full registered name, registration number and registered address]`, which operates the QareGO platform ("**QareGO**", "we", "us"); and

**The merchant:** `[business name]`, `[registration number, if any]`, of `[address]`, represented by `[name and role]` ("**the Merchant**", "you").

It covers the store(s) listed in Schedule 1.

---

## 1. What this agreement is for

1.1 QareGO runs a platform (the QareGO app, the merchant portal at merchant.qarego.com, and related services) that lets customers order from stores and has independent riders deliver those orders.

1.2 This agreement sets the terms on which you list your store(s) on QareGO, receive orders, and are paid.

1.3 You are an independent business. Nothing in this agreement makes you an employee, agent, partner or joint venturer of QareGO.

## 2. Joining and store approval

2.1 To go live, each store must have, in the merchant portal: a store photo, its address and map pin, opening hours, and at least three items (with photos, except for laundries and gas stations).

2.2 Pharmacies must upload a valid Pharmacy Council licence, and gas stations a valid NPA LPG retail licence. You must tell QareGO straight away if a licence expires, is suspended or is withdrawn.

2.3 QareGO reviews each store before it goes live and may ask for changes. QareGO may refuse to list a store.

## 3. Your responsibilities

3.1 **Accurate listing.** Keep your menu or product list, prices, photos, descriptions, options, availability and opening hours accurate and up to date.

3.2 **Legal goods only.** Sell only goods you are legally allowed to sell, and hold every licence and permit your business needs.

3.3 **Quality and safety.** Prepare, store and pack orders safely and hygienically, in line with the law, and hand them over in good condition (sealed where appropriate). You are responsible for the quality, safety and contents of what you sell.

3.4 **Pharmacies.** Check every prescription before supplying a prescription-only medicine, and supply only what the law allows. You decide whether to supply each item. QareGO does not give medical advice.

3.5 **Handling orders.** Accept or reject new orders promptly. Mark orders ready accurately. Hand an order only to the rider assigned to it in the app (or, for pickup orders, to the customer).

3.6 **Customer information.** Use customers' names, phone numbers, addresses and prescriptions only to fulfil their orders. Keep them confidential, and don't contact customers for any other purpose.

3.7 **Accounts.** Keep your sign-in details private. Give staff their own cook accounts in the portal. You are responsible for everything done through your accounts.

3.8 **Payout details.** Keep your payout mobile money number correct. QareGO is not responsible for payments sent to a number you gave.

## 4. Prices and fees

4.1 **Your prices.** You set the price of each item. Customers pay your listed price for items, plus a delivery fee (for deliveries) and a service fee, both set by QareGO.

4.2 **Commission.** For each completed order, QareGO earns a commission on the item price (the order subtotal, after any discount you set):
- **[15]%** for restaurants, grocery shops, pharmacies and laundries;
- **[5]%** of the gas price for gas stations.

QareGO may change the commission by giving you at least **[30] days'** notice in writing (including by SMS, email or in the portal). Orders placed before the change keep the old rate.

4.3 **Free period.** QareGO may give a store a period with no commission, starting when the store goes live or at another date QareGO sets. The end date is shown in the merchant portal. Orders placed during the free period carry no commission, even if completed after it ends. After that, the normal commission applies with no further notice. QareGO may extend a free period, or end it early with **[7] days'** notice.

4.4 **Delivery and service fees** are paid by the customer and belong to QareGO and the riders. They are not part of your earnings.

4.5 **No other fees.** QareGO charges no sign-up, listing or monthly fee unless both parties agree otherwise in writing.

## 5. Payment

5.1 **Cash delivery orders.** The rider pays you your share (the item price minus commission) in cash when collecting the order.

5.2 **Mobile money orders.** QareGO collects the customer's payment and sends your share to your payout mobile money number when the order is delivered or collected. If a transfer fails, QareGO will retry it once the cause is fixed.

5.3 **Cash pickup orders.** The customer pays you the full amount. QareGO's share (the commission and the service fee) is recorded against your store's balance in the portal and is payable to QareGO.

5.4 **Your balance.** Amounts you owe QareGO (clause 5.3 and clause 6.3) are shown in the portal. You must pay them `[within 7 days / weekly / as agreed]` by `[mobile money / cash to an authorised QareGO representative]`. QareGO may deduct amounts you owe from payments due to you.

5.5 **Records.** The portal shows each order, its commission and its payout status. If you think something is wrong, tell QareGO within **[30] days** of the order.

5.6 **Taxes.** You are responsible for the taxes on your sales. QareGO is responsible for the taxes on its commission and fees.

## 6. Cancellations and refunds

6.1 Customers may cancel an order until you accept it. QareGO refunds mobile money payments for cancelled orders.

6.2 You may reject or cancel an order you can't fulfil. Do so as early as possible.

6.3 If you cancel after a rider has accepted the delivery, the rider is paid for the trip and the charge is added to your balance: half the delivery fee once a rider has accepted, and the full delivery fee once the rider has reached your store or is carrying the order. If QareGO cancels, QareGO bears this charge.

6.4 If an order is wrong, incomplete or not fit to eat or use because of something you did or didn't do, QareGO may refund the customer and recover the amount from you, after giving you a chance to respond.

## 7. Customer complaints

7.1 QareGO handles customer support and will pass on complaints about your store. You agree to respond within **[48] hours**.

7.2 Customers can rate their order. Ratings are shown to other customers.

## 8. Brand and content

8.1 You allow QareGO to show your store name, logo, photos, menu and prices in the QareGO app, website and marketing, for as long as this agreement lasts.

8.2 You confirm you own, or have permission to use, the photos and content you upload.

8.3 You may say your store is "on QareGO" and use the QareGO name and logo for that purpose, in the form QareGO provides.

## 9. Suspension and ending the agreement

9.1 You may end this agreement at any time by telling QareGO in writing. Orders already accepted must still be completed.

9.2 QareGO may pause your store, or end this agreement, by notice if you: break this agreement and don't fix it within **[7] days** of being told; lose a licence you need; repeatedly reject or cancel orders; receive repeated serious complaints; or act fraudulently or unsafely. In serious cases QareGO may pause your store straight away.

9.3 When the agreement ends, any amounts owed by either side remain payable.

## 10. Liability

10.1 You are responsible for the goods you sell and for any loss or harm they cause. You agree to cover QareGO for claims by customers or others arising from your goods, your breach of this agreement or the law, or your staff.

10.2 QareGO works to keep the platform available and accurate, but it relies on mobile networks, maps, payment providers and independent riders, and may sometimes be unavailable. To the extent the law allows, QareGO is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for loss of profit. QareGO's total liability under this agreement is limited to **[the commission QareGO earned from your store in the 3 months before the claim]**.

10.3 Riders are independent. QareGO will help resolve problems with deliveries and may compensate you where a rider loses or damages an order after collecting it, under its policies at the time.

## 11. Data protection

11.1 Each party will handle personal data in line with Ghana's Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843). Customer information is handled as described in QareGO's [Privacy Policy](https://qarego.com/privacy).

## 12. General

12.1 **Changes.** QareGO may update this agreement by giving you at least **[30] days'** notice. If you don't agree, you may end the agreement before the change takes effect.

12.2 **Notices** may be sent by email, SMS, WhatsApp or the merchant portal to the contact details you gave QareGO.

12.3 **Disputes.** The parties will first try to settle any dispute in good faith. If they can't within **[30] days**, `[mediation / arbitration under the Alternative Dispute Resolution Act, 2010 (Act 798) / the courts of Ghana]`.

12.4 **Governing law.** This agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Ghana.

12.5 This agreement, with the Terms of Service, is the whole agreement between the parties about its subject.
